text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After being defeated in the Satsuki<n>Sho, Biwa
Hayahide decides to<n>recalculate her equation from
scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Taishin's<n>extraordinary
determination—the<n>destabilizing factor—won't be
easy to<n>account for.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Winning Ticket shouts<n>her resolve to
win the Japanese<n>Derby at the top of her lungs,
almost<n>as if to convince herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Can we rebuild Biwa Hayahide's<n>winning equation
in time for the<n>Japanese Derby, where both of her
indomitable rivals will be?
